title: ISO 17635:2025 — Non-destructive testing of welds — General rules for metallic materials
locator: Guidelines for selecting weld NDT methods and evaluating results based on quality requirements, material, weld thickness, welding process and extent of testing.
notes: NDT验收等级不能直接解释为ISO 5817/ISO 10042质量等级；方法选择和验收准则应在检验计划中明确。
